name: Marie-Ève Tremblay
bio:
Marie-Ève's journey into motorsport began with a fascination for aerodynamics ignited by watching Formula 1 races with her father. She pursued a degree in mechanical engineering, specializing in fluid dynamics. Her career started at a small engineering firm, where she quickly gained experience in CFD analysis and wind tunnel testing. A chance encounter with a racing engineer led to an opportunity to join a junior formula team. 

Marie-Ève thrives on the collaborative aspect of motorsport. She believes in fostering a team environment where ideas are freely exchanged and innovation is encouraged. Her approach to leading the aero department at Dick Johnson Racing is rooted in a data-driven methodology, combined with a keen eye for identifying subtle aerodynamic improvements. Her ability to translate complex data into practical solutions makes her an invaluable asset. What sets Marie-Ève apart is her relentless pursuit of perfection and her unwavering commitment to pushing the boundaries of aerodynamic performance.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, slightly wavy, often pulled back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Marie-Ève has a focused intensity in her eyes and a no-nonsense demeanor that speaks to her dedication.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with aerodynamic calculations and sketches.
Has a habit of tapping her pen against her teeth when deeply focused on a problem.
Insists on using a specific brand of coffee, claiming it enhances her analytical abilities.
